name: productos
description: ProductOS — a complete operating system for taking an AI product from idea to revenue with AI agents — apps, agent plugins and skills, MCP servers, chat assistants, developer tools, services, websites, and digital products. Installs inside your product's repo as productos/, optionally ships with a coach-composed programme plan, and runs four phases (Define, Design, Develop, Distribute), each with checklists, worksheets, and 44 skills that write every output to your repo's docs/ folder.

interface.shortDescription: From idea to revenue with AI agents
interface.longDescription: ProductOS guides you through four phases — Define, Design, Develop, Distribute — each with checklists, worksheets, skills, and an orchestrator that adapts every step to your product's shape: app, extension, agent plugin or skill, MCP server, chat assistant, developer tool, service, website, or digital product. Your AI agent does the heavy lifting; the system keeps it honest, and every output lands in your repo's docs/ folder — one source of truth for your offer, design, build plan, and growth.
